capture_method: Anonymous requests against the official www.tumblr.com web API (the public web-client bearer token embedded in every tumblr.com page) plus the legacy per-blog JSON API; all responses stored verbatim under scraped_data/ and normalized into the frozen source_data/ JSON snapshots. Images were downloaded directly from the tumblr media CDNs (64.media.tumblr.com, 44.media.tumblr.com, va.media.tumblr.com, static.tumblr.com) with aspect-preserving recompression. Review-fix additions (2026-09-28, same snapshot day): tag-hub editorial descriptions scraped verbatim from the tagged page HTML into scraped_data/tagged_editorial/, and the teaboot blog (info + newest posts) scraped verbatim into scraped_data/blogs/teaboot/; both merged into source_data by scripts_dev/scrape_tag_editorials.py and scripts_dev/scrape_teaboot.py, adding no new managed assets.

records.scope: Flask application implementing the tumblr.com mirror: logged-out home with the trending feed, Explore with topic hub cards, tag hub pages (follower counts, new-post counts, editorial descriptions, related tags), search with Top/Recent tabs plus blog/tag/community suggestions, blog pages with header/avatar/theme colors and post grids, per-blog archives grouped by month, post permalinks with like/reblog note rails, and — for the four benchmark users — dashboard, likes, following, activity notifications, inbox conversations with message sending, ask submission, reblogging with comments, like/follow toggles, a text/photo/quote/link post composer, settings, and registration.

Deterministic build-time seeder. Materializes the frozen source_data/ snapshots into SQLite (blogs, posts with content blocks and reblog trails, tag hubs, tag membership, saved searches, like/reblog/reply notes, trending feed) and builds the mirror-native benchmark fixtures: Alice/Bob/Carol/David with their own blogs, follows, likes, reblogs, inbox conversations, and activity notifications. Whole-function idempotence gates keep /reset byte-identical; PYTHONHASHSEED=0 keeps builds reproducible.

508 blogs as served by www.tumblr.com on 2026-09-28: names, titles, descriptions, avatars, header images, theme colors, updated timestamps, post counts (16 primary blogs pulled with 3 pages of posts each), ask/messaging flags. Includes the teaboot blog — the original blog in the reblog trail of the high-note CCTV post — captured from the same per-blog info endpoint on 2026-09-28 during the review fix (avatar reuses the already-mirrored file; no new managed assets).

1,479 unique posts with their upstream ids, content blocks (text, image, link, quote, audio, video, poll), reblog trails, tags, timestamps, note/like/reblog counts and answer-post asker metadata, normalized to local media paths. Includes teaboot's three newest text-only posts, captured from the per-blog posts endpoint on 2026-09-28 during the review fix (no media blocks, so no new managed assets).

12 tag hub pages (art, photography, space, cats, nature, travel, food, fashion, architecture, books, vintage, gif) with the real follower counts, new-post counts, hub header images, editorial descriptions, related-tag rows and the ordered tagged feed captured from www.tumblr.com/tagged/<tag>. Editorial descriptions come from the tagged page HTML (___INITIAL_STATE___.queries editorialDescription/editorialDescriptionText, captured 2026-09-28 during the review fix): six hubs show one upstream (art, photography, travel, food, books, fashion) and the other six serve none, exactly as mirrored.

8 saved searches (pixel art, space, cats, coffee, mountains, poetry, cyberpunk, ocean) with top/recent post ordering, matching blogs, tag suggestions, communities and typeahead results from the upstream search timelines.
The Explore trending feed: the 40 posts tumblr.com's explore endpoint served on 2026-09-28, in upstream order.

6,985 like/reblog/reply notes across the 150 highest-note posts, exactly as served by the upstream notes endpoint: note type, timestamp, blog name/title and avatar for each liker/reblogger, plus total counts per post.
Feed membership index recording which scraped endpoint each post appeared in (blog feeds, tag feeds, search timelines, explore), for provenance and debugging.

9,207 files (458 MB) downloaded from tumblr media CDNs: post images and GIFs (keyed by upstream media_key so reblogs share one file), audio/video posters, 7 playable tumblr-hosted mp4 videos, blog avatars, note-writer avatars, blog headers, tag hub headers and related-tag thumbnails. Every file's upstream URL, byte size and sha256 is recorded in asset_inventory.json; asset_inventory passes scripts/check_asset_inventory.py.
schema_version 1 inventory of every managed static asset with bytes, sha256 and the upstream source URL it was fetched from.
Verbatim API responses and the image download manifest used to build source_data/; gitignored and dockerignored, never shipped in the image.
